title: At an assumed −110 both replays end ahead: +95.0 units after 1,284 college football signals and +45.4 after 607 NFL signals, with losing stretches of up to 16.5 and 19.0 units
name: Units won at an assumed −110, signal by signal, in each sport's forecast replay
shows: Each line adds the units won or lost, one unit a bet, as each signal's game is played, in kickoff order; a push adds nothing.
not_shows: These are not units anyone could have won: every bet is at the consensus close at an assumed −110, while the live rule bets 1 to 3 days early at one book's price, under a −115 cap.
sample: 1,284 college football signals (2006–25) and 607 NFL signals (2004–25)
